title: County of Osona
capsule: The County of Osona was a Carolingian march county in what is now central Catalonia, centered on Vic (Vicus Ausonensis), established after Louis the Pious's forces recovered the region from Andalusi control around 798. It was repopulated and ecclesiastically reorganized by Wilfred the Hairy after 879, who settled free colonists and restored the bishopric of Vic, binding the county closely to Barcelona. The county passed through successive Catalan march arrangements and was absorbed into the nascent Principality of Catalonia around 1111 when its last count and countess died without direct heirs.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The county's boundaries are reconstructed from Carolingian diplomas and Catalan comital records; the core area around Vic is clear, but outer march limits are approximate.
